Name: Convenient Chests 2
Author: SummerFleur
Description:
This is an reforge mod based on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2196]aEnigmatic's Convenient Chests[/url], mainly fixed some bugs and added a lot of new features.

此 mod 为 [url=https://github.com/aEnigmatic]aEnigmatic[/url] 开发的 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2196]Convenient Chests[/url] 的重制版，修复了一些 Bug，同时在原有功能的基础上添加了大量新的功能。（中文版简介请往下划）

[b][size=4]Description[/size][/b]

Combines features of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1787]StackToNearbyChests[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1300]CategorizeChests[/url], and allows crafting from nearby chests.

[b]1. Chest Alias: Add alias to your chests[/b]

Facing a pile of chests, do you often forget what's inside? In the vanilla game, the common solution is placing a sign behind the chest, which takes up extra space and can be easily edited by accident while holding an item.

In version 2.0.0, this mod introduces the Chest Notes feature. You can add a note to each chest. Simply hover your mouse over the chest to see the note, helping you quickly find the items you need among a cluster of chests.

[img width=400]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/32558/32558-1774525547-506084565.png[/img]

[b]2. Chest Categories: Categorize chests by item type[/b]

This is a core feature carried over from the original mod. You can set item categories for chests to specify what can be stored inside. By pressing the quick storage key or clicking the button next to the chest, items matching the category will be stored into chests.

[img width=400]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/32558/32558-1774525542-971720489.png[/img]

[b]3. Quick Storage: Store items into chests with one click[/b]

Stand near a chest and press the quick storage key to stack items defined by the "Category" feature. You can also stack items into chests anywhere regardless of distance or map restrictions(disabled by default), provided the chest has a set category or already contains similar items.

This mod also provide an auto-storage feature, this feature currently applies only when you are in the Mines, Skull Cavern, and Volcano Dungeon. Items are automatically stored remotely every 30 minutes to prevent inventory overflow.

[b]4. Item Locking: Prevent important items from being accidentally stored[/b]

Have you ever taken items out for a quest, only to accidentally hit the quick storage key and have them silently return to the chest? Or perhaps you were deep in the Skull Caverns and accidentally stored your vital supplies back home?

These situations can be solved with the Item Locking feature. Simply select and lock specific items to prevent them from being automatically stored in chests.

[img width=400]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/32558/32558-1774525548-1027436650.png[/img]

[b]5. Chest Snapshots: Save category configurations[/b]

Tired of re-setting your item categories every time you start a new save file?

In version 2.0.0, this mod introduces the Chest Snapshot feature. You can save your current category settings as a snapshot and import it into a new save. This allows you to share the same item categorization across different save files.

[img width=400]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/32558/32558-1774525542-422902698.png[/img]

[b]6. Quick Crafting: Craft items using materials from nearby chests[/b]

Stand near your chests and open the crafting or cooking menu to use materials directly from nearby chests.

Note: If you also have the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11115]Better Crafting[/url] mod installed, this feature may not work. However, since Better Crafting includes its own version of this functionality, it is recommended to use that instead if both mods are present.

[img width=400]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/32558/32558-1742677629-1738026726.png[/img]

[b]7. Compatibility Optimization: Improved compatibility with Convenient Inventory[/b]

In older versions, design inconsistencies in overlapping features between the two mods caused issues when both were installed. I have submitted compatibility patches to the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10384]Convenient Inventory[/url] mod. It is expected that its next version (estimated 1.6.1, depending on the author) will be fully compatible with this mod, ensuring mutual compatibility.

[b][size=4]Q&A[/size][/b]

Q: Is there any conflict mods?
A: No conflict mods found currently. If you find another conflict mod, please submit bugs on the [url=https://github.com/SummerFleur2997/StardewMods/issues]Github issue tracker[/url], please avoid leave comments at nexus because I don't check it often.

Q: Can I migrate the data from the original mod to this mod?
A: Of course! You can do it easily. First, makes sure that you're not running a game save, then open your mods folder, and click the "ConvenientChests" folder, copy the "savedata" folder to the "ConvenientChestsUnofficial" folder. Now, the data have been migrated successfully. And if you want migrate data across devices, you can also use this method.

Q: Does this mod supports i18n?
A: Yes, contributions are welcome, you can commit your translation on [url=https://github.com/SummerFleur2997/ConvenientChests#translating-the-mods]Github[/url], or directly upload them on nexus. English is not my first language, so for native English users, if you want to improve the current English translation, you can also come and help!

[b][size=4]模组功能介绍[/size][/b]

[b]1. 箱子备注功能：为你的箱子添加备注[/b]

面对一大堆箱子，你是否经常忘记里面装了什么？在原版游戏中，通常需要在箱子后放置牌子来标记，但这不仅占用空间，而且拿着物品时很容易误触修改牌子内容。

在 2.0.0 版本中，本模组引入了箱子备注功能。你可以为每个箱子添加备注，只需将鼠标悬停在箱子上即可查看备注信息，助你在一堆箱子中快速找到所需物品。

[img width=400]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/32558/32558-1774525547-506084565.png[/img]

[b]2. 箱子分类功能：将箱子按物品分类[/b]

这是本模组延续至今的核心功能。你可以为箱子设定物品分类，规定箱子里可以放入什么。在按下快速存储键或点击箱子旁的按钮时，即可将符合分类的物品存入箱中。

[img width=400]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/32558/32558-1774525542-971720489.png[/img]

[b]3. 快速存储功能：一键将物品存入箱子[/b]

站在箱子附近按下快速存储键，即可将先前通过“分类”功能设定好的物品存入箱子。此外，你还可以无视距离与地图限制（默认关闭）将物品堆叠至任意位置的箱子，前提是该箱子已设定分类或已包含同类物品。

模组同时还提供了自动远程存储功能，此功能目前仅适用于在矿井、骷髅洞穴、火山地牢中探险时。每隔 30 分钟自动将物品远程存放到箱子中，避免背包爆满。

[b]4. 锁定物品功能：防止重要物品被误存放[/b]

你是否遇到过这种情况：从箱子取出物品准备做任务，却误触快速存储键导致物品被放回；或者在骷髅洞穴探险时，误将重要补给品远程存回了家里的箱子？

以上种种误操作都可以通过“锁定物品”功能解决。选定几个物品将其锁定，即可防止它们被自动存入箱子。

[img width=400]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/32558/32558-1774525548-1027436650.png[/img]

[b]5. 箱子快照功能：保存箱子的分类状态[/b]

你是否厌倦了每次开新存档都要为箱子重新设置一遍物品分类？

在 2.0.0 版本中，本模组引入了箱子快照功能。你可以将当前的箱子分类保存为快照，在新存档中导入即可同步原有设置，真正实现不同存档共享同一套物品分类方案。

[img width=400]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/32558/32558-1774525542-422902698.png[/img]

[b]6. 快捷打造功能：使用附近箱子里的材料打造物品[/b]

站在箱子附近打开打造或烹饪界面，即可直接使用附近箱子里的材料进行制作。

注意： 若同时安装了 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11115]Better Crafting[/url] 模组，本功能可能会失效。但由于该模组自带类似功能，建议在同时安装时优先使用 Better Crafting 提供的功能。

[img width=400]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/32558/32558-1742677629-1738026726.png[/img]

[b]7. 兼容性优化：与 Convenient Inventory 模组的兼容优化[/b]

在旧版本中，两个模组在部分重叠功能上存在设计冲突，导致同时安装时可能出现体验问题。目前我已向 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10384]Convenient Inventory[/url] 提交了兼容性修改，预计其下一个版本（预计为 1.6.1，取决于该模组作者）将完全兼容本模组，实现双向兼容。

[b][size=4]Q&A[/size][/b]

Q: 是否存在冲突模组？
A: 暂时未发现冲突模组，若您发现了其他冲突模组，请在 [url=https://github.com/SummerFleur2997/StardewMods/issues]Github issue[/url] 处报告，请尽量不要在 nexus 上留言，因为不常看。

Q: 如何迁移存档数据？
A: 新老模组均将数据存放于模组目录内的 savedata 文件夹下，若需要将原模组的存档信息转移至新模组、或者跨设备迁移存档数据，只需要将 savedata 文件夹复制到模组目录下即可，迁移数据时应当先确保当前存档不处于运行状态。
